svg.aria-label: Featured work: Water Situation & Forecasting Dashboards (Next.js, Tailwind, DaisyUI); Rainfall Forecasting App (Next.js, Leaflet, GeoPandas); IoT Monitoring Platform (Node-RED, MQTT, InfluxDB, PostgreSQL); Interactive Basin Management Diagrams (React, SVG); AquaGuard (Next.js, Node-RED, SVG); CPA Tutoring Platform (Supabase Realtime, JWT).
svg.title: Featured work: Water Situation & Forecasting Dashboards (Next.js, Tailwind, DaisyUI); Rainfall Forecasting App (Next.js, Leaflet, GeoPandas); IoT Monitoring Platform (Node-RED, MQTT, InfluxDB, PostgreSQL); Interactive Basin Management Diagrams (React, SVG); AquaGuard (Next.js, Node-RED, SVG); CPA Tutoring Platform (Supabase Realtime, JWT).

g.text: KPI cards, flood summary tables, map filters and AI summaries over Mike 11, ANN, ML/Smart and SWAMP models.
WRF rainfall by province on a Leaflet choropleth, backed by a GeoPandas and Shapely aggregation pipeline.
Cloud and local Node-RED flows for real-time water level, gate and CCTV monitoring, with role-based JWT auth.
SVG diagrams of Thai river basins with React overlay components for real-time data.
Mobile-first water monitoring app with a Node-RED backend, QR-based device onboarding and custom SVG charts.
Full-stack tutoring platform with a CMS-managed admin panel, custom JWT auth and live check-in tracking.
